answer: The cedar multiplier is published, charged in forge, and voyage lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 14 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4007 identities would post 1362 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
